description: Build a supplement plan (take / skip / optional) for a fitness goal. Inputs: goal, optional diet, budget_per_month or budget_tier, region (EU or US), current supplement names, and age. Returns label doses, schedule, cost per day and month, third-party testing, and safety flags (caffeine vs 400 mg/day, duplicate ingredients, age gate). Refuses medical, pregnancy and medication cases. Read-only.
name: plan_stack
title: Plan a supplement stack
